skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand fundamental knowledge about brand valuation, legal aspects, principles, and procedures of brand valuation, and apply this knowledge in practical brand valuation scenarios.
Understand legal frameworks related to brand valuation and apply them in practical scenarios.
Understand and apply research methodologies in brand valuation.
Analyze and interpret data related to brand valuation using quantitative and qualitative techniques.
Collaborate effectively in group settings, contribute to group discussions, and manage group dynamics.
Prepare and deliver presentations on brand valuation topics.
Write reports on brand valuation studies and findings.
Identify and solve problems related to brand valuation using appropriate methods and models.
Effectively communicate brand valuation concepts and findings.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and prepare for presentations.
